name: Fridge Stock & Date Tracker
description: Track food by purchase batch with remaining amounts, label dates and opened states; overdue/soon groups with exportable lists
help: Every purchase is its own batch: record amount and unit, the purchase date and the label date you copy from the package; batches on different dates never merge and a missing date stays unknown.
Log consumption or discards against a specific batch and the remaining amount updates; opening only records a date without deducting, plus an optional custom attention date.
The board groups items into overdue, soon (adjustable lead days), unknown date, normal and depleted, sorted by label date so earlier dates get used first.
Same-dimension units (g/kg, ml/L) convert in Rust; count units like pack/box are never guessed against weights. Conservation holds: intake + adjustments − consumed − discarded = remaining.
Undo the latest movement of a batch; editing intake with history keeps an adjustment record and never allows a negative remainder; copy/export lists and a JSON backup.
